study:visual.summary:
I critiqued the shared visual foundation of Audius Studio (main view, all windows opened for frame checks) at 1920x1080, 1366x768, 1024x1366 touch and 360x640 touch, plus 2x close-ups, four themes, hover, focus and lit states, popovers, and the impeccable detector (48 hits: 13 dark-glow, 13 cramped-padding, 9 thin-border-wide-shadow, 6 low-contrast, 1 side-tab; the purple-palette hit is a false positive because the brand requires purple). I edited no project files.

Overall: the Audius brand reads clearly, the dark ladder (#1B1C2A to #444B69) is a sound base, and the Lucide sprite and the 150ms ease-out motion layer are good starts. It does not yet look expert-made, for six reasons:
1. There is no type hierarchy. Every role computes to 15px through a 40-selector !important block, and the song position is only 16.5px.
2. On/selected states use seven or more visual languages across three accents whose token names do not match their colours. The focus ring is the same blue as "selected".
3. Surfaces are flat: panels, windows and popovers share one colour, separated only by 1.2:1 to 1.5:1 hairlines, and the top bar is a box inside a box.
4. Hard-coded Ant-Design-style colours bypass the themes. The daylight theme is visibly broken: the selected stem card's text is 1.17:1, and close buttons render dark red. Nordic and Cyberpunk inherit the Audius-dark header colour and magenta gradient because their theme blocks are incomplete.
5. Readouts use an unloaded monospace font that renders differently on every OS, although Avenir's digits are already tabular.
6. Native range sliders and checkboxes are unthemed, and the brand gradient plus glow is spent on every accent button.

There is also a latent bug: the wallpaper selector `.app-shell` never matches `#app-shell`, so wallpapers never paint, yet the side panels still get purple glass and blur in every theme.

Screenshots and probe scripts are in /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-DAW/717ea5f2-42d2-5656-8044-03574a727b85/scratchpad/design/work/foundation/critique-visual/. Key files:
- 1920x1080-app.png, 1366x768-app.png, 1024x1366t-app.png, 360x640t-app.png
- 1920x1080-z-topbar-left.png, 1920x1080-z-topbar-right.png, 1920x1080-z-toolbar.png, 1920x1080-z-leftpanel.png, 1920x1080-z-bottom.png
- allwin-1920.png
- theme-daylight.png, theme-nordic.png, theme-forest.png
- state-focus-tool.png, state-mute-solo.png, menu-options.png, menu-more.png
- detect.json

Outside this area (reported here only so the right pass picks it up):
- The probe found track-header M/S/x buttons overlapping #hscroll-slider at 360x640. This belongs to the phone/playlist pass.
- Feature names such as "Audius Master Limiter" and "Audius Parametric EQ" may imply an official Audius product. This is a copy question for the lead.

findings.title: Hard-coded colours bypass the theme tokens and break the daylight theme
findings.where: styles.css: .asset-card.selected-stem bg #27313d (l.900), .asset-card:hover #4b586b (896), .tiny-btn/.asset-actions button/.modal-card border #3c4757 (818, 938, 1563), .tool-btn/.mini-btn/.toolbar-select border #353f4d (675, 728), .transport-btn border #394352 (432), .bpm-step-btn #1c222b/#2f3844 (503-504), .panel-close-btn #2b1d20/#4a3034/#ffa39e (791-797), danger #6b2629/#ffa39e/#29181b (705-706, 837-838, 949-952, 1079-1081), .trk-btn #3a4452 + mute #d4380d/#ff7a45 + solo #d48806/#ffd666 (1187-1220), .nudge-btn #384352 (1339), .meter-bar #0c0e11/#272f38, .track-meter-mini #0d1014; app.js 1914/1937 (#ffa39e on canvas)
findings.evidence: With data-theme=daylight, the computed .asset-card.selected-stem bg is rgb(39,49,61) under #343B49 text, a 1.17:1 contrast, so the selected stem name is invisible (theme-daylight.png). .panel-close-btn renders as a near-black red square, BPM steppers and meters as black blocks, and the 'Clear' danger text #FFA39E on #E7E7EA is 1.55:1. The same transport border rgb(57,67,82) appears in every theme. The values come from the Ant Design palette (volcano/gold/red), not the Audius palette.
findings.proposal:
Add role tokens to every theme block and replace each literal. audius-dark values:
- --border-subtle #30344B, --border #3C425D, --border-strong #4C5374
- --danger #F9344C, --danger-fill #D81F38 (white text 5.03:1), --danger-text #FF8A97, --danger-soft color-mix(in srgb, var(--danger) 14%, transparent)
- --state-mute #F08A24 and --state-solo #F5C842, both with --on-state #1B1C2A text
- --state-play #15D864 (on-text #0A2416, 8.6:1), --state-record = --danger
- --meter-bg = --surface-0; meter gradient --meter-ok #15D864, --meter-warn #F5C842, --meter-clip #F9344C

daylight values: --border-subtle #E3E2E7, --border #D6D5DB, --border-strong #BEBCC6, --danger-fill #D0021B, --danger-text #B0001A, --meter-bg #E7E7EA.

Delete every literal hex outside the theme blocks. A simple grep check (no #hex outside lines 1-240) keeps it that way. Expose the danger and state colours to the canvas via getComputedStyle so app.js stops hard-coding #ffa39e.

findings.title: Incomplete theme contract: 4 themes inherit Audius-dark surfaces and the magenta gradient
findings.where: styles.css theme blocks l.1-240 (obsidian, cyberpunk, platinum-slate and nordic lack --bg-header; cyberpunk, nordic and obsidian lack --audius-gradient; 8 themes lack --audius-coin-gradient); hard-coded brand !important block l.2659-2696 (#btn-mode-song.active, #btn-mode-pat.active, .cr-step.active, .cr-led.on/.fx-led.on, .action-btn.success); .topbar border-image l.2456; obsidian block is dead (not in the #theme-select options)
findings.evidence: Undefined custom properties inherit from :root, which carries the audius-dark values. On nordic and cyberpunk, .fl-window-header computes rgb(42,46,67) (= audius-dark #2A2E43) and .tool-btn.active computes the #5B23E1→#CC0FE0 gradient. SONG stays a magenta #CC0FE0→#7E1BCC gradient on forest and nordic (theme-nordic.png, theme-forest.png), and so does the top border-image.
findings.proposal:
Define one complete role contract and require every theme to set all of it:
- --surface-0..3, --border-subtle/--border/--border-strong
- --text-primary/--text-secondary/--text-muted
- --accent, --accent-fill, --accent-hover, --accent-text, --on-accent, --accent-gradient
- --select-bg, --select-edge, --info, --focus
- --state-play/mute/solo/record, --danger*

Keep the old names as aliases (--accent-orange: var(--accent); --accent-teal: var(--info); --accent-amber: var(--accent-text)) so app.js and later passes keep working. Rewrite l.2659-2696 to use var(--accent-fill)/var(--accent-gradient)/var(--state-*), and use var(--accent-gradient) for the .topbar border-image. Remove the orphan obsidian block or add it to the select.

findings.title: No type hierarchy: every role is 15px, and the song position is barely bigger than a menu label
findings.where: styles.css l.4065-4103 (40-selector `font-size: 15px !important` list), base `button, input, select, textarea {font-size:14px}` (~l.270), .readout-main 16.5px, #bpm-input 16px, .panel-header/.audius-panel-heading/.fl-win-title/.sub-header/.fx-rack-head/.trellis-dock-head; uppercase titles in index.html source ('AUDIUS LIBRARY', 'PLAYLIST', 'TRACKS', 'CLIP / SEGMENT INSPECTOR', 'QUICK SLICE / REARRANGEMENT')
findings.evidence: Computed sizes: panel titles 15px/600-700, menu items 15/600, track names 15/600, asset names 15/600, meta 15/400, buttons 15/500, position readout 16.5/700, BPM 16/700. Hierarchy rests only on shouting uppercase and weights up to 800/900. 800 resolves to the Heavy 900 face, an extra font download. Section labels such as 'SELECTED TRACK CHANNEL & EQ' wrap to 2 lines in the inspector (allwin-1920.png). In the FL reference, the song position (1:01:00) is the biggest type on screen.
findings.proposal:
Define a role scale and replace the !important list with base rules:
- --text-label 15px/1.35 w500 (controls, meta; the floor)
- --text-body 16px/1.5 w400 (inspector copy, dialogs, touch controls)
- --text-title 16px/1.3 w600 (window/panel titles, sentence case)
- --text-section 15px/1.3 w600, colour --text-secondary, letter-spacing .02em, no uppercase (sub-header, fx-rack-head, trellis heads)
- --text-heading 20px/1.25 w600 (dialog titles)
- --readout-lg 22px/1 w600 tabular (song position), --readout-md 20px/1 w600 (BPM), --readout-sm 15px/1 w500 (time sub, dB values)

Weights limited to 400/500/600/700. Set `button,input,select,textarea{font:inherit; font-size:var(--text-label)}` once and delete the 40-selector list. Ask the lead to change the uppercase source strings to Title Case (copy change).

findings.title: Colour roles collide: three accents with misleading names and seven 'on' styles, and focus looks like selection
findings.where: tokens --accent-orange (magenta), --accent-amber (lavender), --accent-teal (blue); .tool-btn.active/.tiny-btn.accent/.action-btn.accent gradient + glow (l.2659); #btn-mode-song.active (2693); #btn-mode-pat.active solid blue (2700); .transport-btn.active/.mini-btn.toggle-pane.active/.mobile-window-switcher .active rgba(34,211,238,.16) cyan tint (455, 698, 3347); .fl-folder-item.active purple bg + blue text + 3px blue left bar (1790-1794); .asset-card selected 2px blue ring (901); :focus-visible 2px var(--accent-teal) (4289); .status-pill/hint bar text in accent blue (346)
findings.evidence: In one viewport, 'lit' appears as a gradient fill (Draw), a second gradient with a zero-offset halo (SONG), solid blue (PAT), a blue outline (loop, window toggles, phone tab), purple + blue + side bar (folder), an orange-red fill (mute) and gold (solo). The tint is cyan rgba(34,211,238), not the theme blue. The selected folder sets blue text on purple #392B56 (4.48:1, detector low-contrast) with a 3px coloured left border (detector side-tab). The focus ring and the 'selected' asset ring are the same 2px #1BA1F1 (state-focus-tool.png vs 1920x1080-z-leftpanel.png). The status line is printed in accent blue as if it were a link.
findings.proposal:
Give each colour one job:
- --accent #CC0FE0, --accent-fill #B80DCB (white text 5.31:1), --accent-hover #D63FE6, --accent-text #E28BEA (6.5:1 on #242538)
- Lit toggles (aria-pressed=true): solid --accent-fill, white text, inset 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255/.18), 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0/.4); no glow
- Selection: --select-bg #392B56 + 1px --select-edge #D767E1 inset ring; text stays --text-primary; drop the 3px side bar
- --info #1BA1F1 only for time (playhead, loop region, position)
- Status/hint text: --text-secondary, with live values in --text-primary tabular
- --focus #F6F8FC on dark themes and #5B23E1 on daylight: outline 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset 2px. Focus must never share the selection colour.
- --accent-gradient reserved for the logo plus one primary call to action (Export)

Rename tokens to these roles and keep the old names as aliases.

findings.title: Flat surfaces with no elevation ladder: panels, windows and popovers are one colour
findings.where: .left-panel/.right-panel/.fl-subwindow/.topbar-menu-popover/.toolbar-overflow-content/.modal-card; .panel-header uses --bg-panel-alt while .fl-window-header uses --bg-header; .trellis-dock-head is transparent; wallpaper glass rgba(18,11,34,.82) (l.2768-2774); popover and modal shadows 0 16px 40px / 0 18px 48px
findings.evidence: Popovers compute rgb(36,37,56), the same colour as the panels they float over (menu-options.png). Borders are 1.52:1 and controls 1.34:1 against the panel, so windows tiling the screen (allwin-1920.png) read as one grey sheet split by hairlines. Two different title-bar tones sit side by side. The Library panel is rgba(18,11,34,.82), darker than the app background, which inverts elevation. The detector flags 9 'thin border + wide shadow' halos.
findings.proposal:
Define four surfaces per theme and shared depth tokens.

audius-dark:
- --surface-0 #1B1C2A: wells for canvas, inputs, readouts, meters
- --surface-1 #232437: panel and window bodies
- --surface-2 #2C3047: title bars, tool bars, section headers
- --surface-3 #363B55: raised controls and popovers
- --surface-hover #444B69, --surface-press #2A2E43

Shared tokens:
- --bevel: inset 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255/.06) on surface-2/3
- --well: inset 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0/.45), 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255/.04)
- --shadow-1: 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0/.35)
- --shadow-2: 0 2px 6px rgb(0 0 0/.35), 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0/.25)
- --shadow-3 (popover/dialog): 0 12px 28px -8px rgb(0 0 0/.6), 0 2px 6px rgb(0 0 0/.35)
- Window frames: 1px --border plus a 1px rgb(0 0 0/.45) seam under title bars

Daylight: surfaces #EFEFF1 / #F6F5F7 / #FFFFFF / #FFFFFF, shadows rgb(30 20 60/.10-.16), bevel rgb(255 255 255/.8). All title bars use --surface-2.

findings.title: Readouts use a monospace font that never loads, so they render differently on every OS
findings.where: --font-mono (l.26) used by .time-readout/.readout-main/.readout-sub, .bpm-box input and .bpm-decimals, .cursor-info, kbd, mixer dB labels, inspector value labels; no @font-face for JetBrains Mono (audius-fonts.css loads only Avenir 100-900)
findings.evidence: fc-match 'JetBrains Mono' resolves to another font, so readouts fall back to Liberation/DejaVu on Linux, Consolas on Windows and Menlo on macOS. The playlist status sentence 'Bar 1, Beat 1.00 · Snap: 1/8 Step' is set in mono (1920x1080-z-bottomright.png), which is mono as a costume. The BPM mixes fonts and colours ('125' blue, '.000' purple). Measured Avenir Next LT Pro 600 at 20px: '111111' and '000000' are both 72.22px wide, so its digits are already tabular.
findings.proposal:
Set --font-num: var(--font-ui) with font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums lining-nums. Apply it to all readouts, dB values, BPM and the cursor info, and keep --font-mono only as an optional fallback for kbd (or drop it).

Readout primitive `.lcd`:
- background --surface-0, box-shadow var(--well), no border, radius 4px, padding 4px 10px
- main value --readout-lg 22px/600 in --text-primary, separators in --text-muted with 2px side margins
- secondary --readout-sm in --text-secondary

BPM: one font and one colour (--text-primary 20px/600); decimals in --text-muted.

findings.title: Button family sprawl, inconsistent sizes and radii, gradient and glow on every accent, no disabled state
findings.where: .tool-btn, .mini-btn, .tiny-btn(.accent/.danger-tiny), .action-btn(.accent/.success), .transport-btn, .bpm-step-btn, .pat-song-btn, .panel-close-btn, .icon-close, .nudge-btn, .trk-btn, .del-asset-btn, .asset-actions button, .ctx-btn, .cr-channel-btn, .swatch-btn, .topbar-menu>summary, .toolbar-overflow-menu>summary; press rule button:active{transform:scale(.96)} (l.4490)
findings.evidence: About 18 classes serve 5 roles. 14 distinct control heights are in use (16-48px). In one bar: tool buttons 34px with radius 4, tiny-btn 26px, 'More'/'Options' summaries 44px with radius 7 (taller than the 34px tool row at 1920, see 1920x1080-app.png), PAT/SONG 21px with radius 3. Radii in use: 2/3/4/5/7/9px. The gradient plus 0 2px 10px magenta glow is on Draw, Add Track, To Playlist, Render Clip, Paint Pat and Upload Stems. Export uses a second, blue→magenta 'success' gradient beside Upload in the same menu (menu-options.png). No :disabled or [aria-disabled] styling exists.
findings.proposal:
Create one .btn primitive with variants, built on tokens:
- Heights: --control-h-sm 24px, --control-h 32px. One media query (pointer: coarse),(hover: none) sets both to 44px.
- Radii: --radius-xs 2px (chips, meters), --radius-sm 4px (controls), --radius-md 6px (cards, popovers, window frames), --radius-lg 10px (dialogs, sheets)
- Padding: 0 12px (sm 0 8px), gap 6px
- Primary: --accent-fill + white text + --bevel + --shadow-1
- Secondary: --surface-3, 1px --border, --text-primary
- Ghost: transparent, --text-secondary; hover --surface-3 + --text-primary
- Icon-only: square at --control-h
- Toggle: aria-pressed=true gives the lit style
- Danger: ghost with --danger-text; hover --danger-soft; filled --danger-fill only for confirm
- Hover: one surface step up. Pressed: --surface-press + inset 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0/.35) + translateY(1px) instead of scale(.96)
- Disabled: opacity .45, cursor default, no hover

Alias the legacy classes onto the variants so later area passes can drop them.

findings.title: Window title bars use five styles, and every close (x) is styled as a destructive action
findings.where: .panel-header (68px two-row, ls .4px, uppercase source), .fl-window-header (34px, muted title + bold <strong>), .trellis-dock-head (base 10px, heavy uppercase with icon), .fx-rack-head (w800 lavender uppercase), .sub-header (w700 uppercase, wraps), .minimap-label 'PLAYLIST'; .panel-close-btn bg #2B1D20, border #4A3034, colour #FFA39E, 22x22 (l.791-797), #btn-close-mixer solid red
findings.evidence: In allwin-1920.png the Library, Step Rack, Piano Roll, Inspector, Trellis, Mixer and FX chain headers each differ in height, case, weight and colour. The close buttons are red-tinted, so they look identical in kind to the real one-click delete × on track rows (.trk-btn.del-trk) and asset trash buttons, which blurs the danger signal. The reference title bars (14-delay-window-modern-presets.jpg) show one neutral strip: icon, name, dim context, preset arrows, neutral minimise and close.
findings.proposal:
Title bar: `.window-titlebar`
- height 32px (44px touch), background --surface-2, box-shadow var(--bevel), border-bottom 1px rgb(0 0 0/.45), padding 0 6px 0 10px, gap 8px
- leading icon 16px --text-muted; title --text-title (15-16px/600, --text-primary, sentence case); context after a ' · ' in --text-secondary w500
- trailing ghost icon buttons 24x24 (44 touch)
- close is a ghost × in --text-secondary; hover --surface-hover + --text-primary

Section header: `.section-label`, 15px/600 --text-secondary, letter-spacing .02em, padding 8px 10px 6px, border-bottom 1px --border-subtle.

Reserve red for delete and record only.

findings.title: Native range sliders and checkboxes are unthemed and inconsistent
findings.where: input[type=range] styled only with accent-color: --accent-teal in .track-row-Sliders/.zoom-control/#hscroll-slider (744, 1235), --accent-orange in .master-box/.slider-group (546, 1510); input[type=checkbox] native 13x13 (.inspector-flags, Trellis 'Stamp to Playlist')
findings.evidence: The Timeline Scroll is a near-white 1000px bar with a magenta thumb, while the track Vol/Pan sliders beside it are blue (1920x1080-z-bottom.png). The master volume is magenta and the swing slider is white. The unfilled track colour and thumb shape change per browser. Checkboxes are 13px native boxes beside 32px controls.
findings.proposal:
Range: appearance:none; height var(--control-h-sm) (44px touch hit area).
- Track: 4px, radius 2px, background linear-gradient(var(--accent) 0 0) 0/var(--fill,50%) 100% no-repeat, var(--surface-0); box-shadow var(--well)
- Thumb: 14px (20px touch), fill #F6F8FC, 2px var(--accent-fill) border, --shadow-1
- Thumb hover: 0 0 0 4px color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent) 25%,transparent). Focus-visible uses the --focus ring.
- app.js sets --fill on input (one helper)

Checkbox: 16px, radius 3px, 1.5px --border-strong, background --surface-0; checked: --accent-fill with a white Lucide check (stroke 2.5). Use a 30x18 switch for on/off flags such as Reverse and Mute Segment.

findings.title: Top bar and tool row are a box soup of nested bordered containers
findings.where: .audius-logo-lockup, .fl-hint-bar, .transport-group (bg-darkest + border + radius 7) containing .pat-song-btn, .transport-btn, .bpm-box (border) with .bpm-step-btn (border), .time-readout (border), .osc-canvas (border); .tool-cluster of 8 separately bordered .tool-btn
findings.evidence: 1920x1080-z-topbar-right.png shows four levels of outlined boxes (group, then BPM box, then -/+ boxes), and the craft floor bans nested cards. The nine tools in 1920x1080-z-toolbar.png are nine equal-weight bordered pills. The detector flags cramped-padding on .fl-hint-bar, .fl-pattern-selector, .fl-window-header and .panel-header (children flush to the border).
findings.proposal:
Add two primitives for the tool-bar pass to apply without moving anything:
- `.segmented`: one --surface-0 well, 1px --border, radius --radius-sm, padding 2px, gap 0; segments borderless and transparent, separated by 1px --border-subtle; active segment uses the lit style (radius 3px). Covers tools Draw-Pan, PAT/SONG and the transport buttons.
- `.lcd`: the readout well, with no outer border

The hint bar becomes plain --text-secondary text on the bar, with no box. Give every bar padding-block 6px so children never touch the edges.

findings.title: Wallpapers never paint, but side panels still get purple glass and blur
findings.where: styles.css l.2753 `body[data-wallpaper]:not([data-wallpaper="none"]) .app-shell` vs index.html l.95 `<div id="app-shell">`; l.2768-2774 .left-panel/.right-panel rgba(18,11,34,.82) + backdrop-filter blur(8px); app.js l.1725 canvas veil rgba(11,7,22,.68); .playlist-center/.timeline-viewport keep an opaque bg-darkest
findings.evidence: With body data-wallpaper='Aurora-Glow', the computed #app-shell background-image is 'none' and .playlist-center is opaque rgb(27,28,42). The wallpaper feature (a must-keep) is visually dead. Meanwhile the side panels in forest and nordic are tinted Audius-dark purple, and blur runs over a flat colour for no effect.
findings.proposal: Change the selector to #app-shell and let the playlist surfaces go transparent only when a wallpaper is painted. Add a token per theme: --panel-glass: color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface-1) 86%, transparent), with backdrop-filter: blur(12px) saturate(1.1) only under [data-wallpaper]:not([data-wallpaper=none]). Daylight: color-mix(... #FFFFFF 84% ...). Drive the canvas veil from a --wallpaper-veil token instead of literals.

findings.title: Keyboard focus is removed on the tempo and project-name inputs
findings.where: .bpm-box input:focus {outline:none} (l.526-529); .project-name-input:hover,.project-name-input:focus {outline:none} (l.336-342); global :focus-visible (l.4289)
findings.evidence: The (0,2,1) and (0,1,1) specificity of these rules beats `:focus-visible` (0,1,0), so tabbing into BPM shows nothing. The project name shows only a 1px border at 1.5:1. The task requires visible :focus-visible rings.
findings.proposal: Delete both outline:none rules. Use `:where(input,select,textarea):focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--focus);outline-offset:1px}` for wells (offset 1px stays inside tight bars), and keep offset 2px for buttons. --focus is #F6F8FC on dark themes and #5B23E1 on daylight; it must differ from --select-edge.

findings.title: No spacing scale: odd-pixel gaps and paddings everywhere
findings.where: styles.css gap values 1/2/3/4/5/6/7/8/10/12px (15x 3px, 13x 5px, 3x 7px), paddings 0 6/0 7/0 8/0 9/0 10/0 12/0 13/0 15px, clamp(3px,.55vw,9px) !important
findings.evidence: Each cluster uses a different rhythm: tool-cluster gap 4, transport 7, palette 5, brand 10, track-row 6. Separation between groups is barely larger than spacing within them, so the bars read as one even run of boxes rather than tight groups with generous gaps.
findings.proposal: Define a 4-based scale: --space-1 2px (hairline groups), --space-2 4px (inside a segmented control), --space-3 8px (between controls in a cluster), --space-4 12px (control padding-x, panel padding), --space-5 16px (between clusters and sections), --space-6 24px (dialog padding). Rule of thumb: within a group ≤ --space-3, between groups ≥ --space-5, section headers get more space above than below (12px/6px).

findings.title: Contrast failures in accent fills and accent text across themes
findings.where: --accent-orange as a fill with white text (tool-btn.active, tiny-btn.accent, playing), ocean/platinum-slate accent #1BA1F1, daylight --accent-teal as text, .trk-btn.del-trk:hover / danger fills #F9344C
findings.evidence: Detector and computed contrast: white on #CC0FE0 is 4.46:1 (15px/600 is not 'large', so it fails AA). White on #1BA1F1 (ocean and platinum primary) is 2.83:1. Daylight #1BA1F1 text on #F6F5F7 is 2.61:1 (selected folder, hint, BPM) and on #F0E0FF selection 2.27:1. amoled teal on selected is 3.49:1. White on #F9344C on hover is 3.73:1. Folder active blue on purple is 4.48:1.
findings.proposal:
Give each theme an --accent-fill tuned for white text and keep the bright hue for borders and fills without text:
- audius-dark/daylight/amethyst #B80DCB (5.31:1)
- ocean/platinum #0B76B8 (4.89:1)
- amoled #8E3CE0
- --danger-fill #D81F38 (5.03:1)

Accent text on daylight: #9A0AAB (6.43:1) or #0B6FAD (4.97:1). Verify every token pair with a small script in the themes sweep.

findings.title: !important sprawl re-declares the same primitive at every breakpoint
findings.where: 301 !important in styles.css; .trk-btn sized in 12 rules (l.1187, 2366, 3509, 3552, 3674, 3800, 3869, ...); .tiny-btn 10 rules, .transport-btn 10, .asset-card 10, .mini-btn 9, .panel-header 9; 15px floor list l.4065-4103; touch 44px list l.4111-4130
findings.evidence: Each layer patches sizes per class with !important, which is why heights drift (14 values) and why base rules like `font-size:14px` survive underneath. Any later area pass has to out-shout these layers.
findings.proposal: Move sizing to variables: :root{--control-h:32px;--control-h-sm:24px;--text-control:15px} and @media (pointer:coarse),(hover:none){:root{--control-h:44px;--control-h-sm:44px;--text-control:16px}}. Primitives use min-height:var(--control-h); font-size:var(--text-control). Then delete the per-class !important size and font lists, re-running the harness probe (doc width, clipped, <15px, <44px) at all 7 viewports after each removal to confirm no behaviour change.

findings.title: Motion: ambient logo pulse, oversized press scale, no fade under reduced motion
findings.where: .audius-logo-lockup animation audiusLockupBorderPulse 7.2s infinite with a zero-offset magenta halo (l.2471, 2597-2605), audiusGlyphPulse, button:active scale(.96) (l.4490), reduced-motion popovers animation:none (l.4546-4553), ad hoc durations 0.04/0.05/0.08/0.12/0.15/160/220ms
findings.evidence: A border glow pulses in the corner every 7.2s during long sessions and competes with the tempo-synced beat pulse, which should be the one authored motion. The detector counts 13 dark-glow hits. scale(.96) visibly shrinks wide 248px buttons. Under reduced motion, menus pop in with no feedback at all, while the brief asks for a gentle alternative.
findings.proposal:
Motion tokens:
- --dur-press 80ms, --dur-fast 120ms (colour/hover), --dur-base 180ms (popovers), --dur-slow 240ms (sheets)
- --ease-out cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), --ease-in-out cubic-bezier(.65,0,.35,1)

Changes:
- Remove the border pulse and halo. Keep the wordmark crossfade the owner asked for.
- Press feedback: translateY(1px) + inset shadow.
- Reduced motion: popovers fade opacity 0→1 over 120ms, no transform.

findings.title: Iconography mixes Lucide strokes, raster coins and text plus signs
findings.where: index.html: TokenAUDIO.png in the Library heading (l.444), tier coin PNGs in folder items (455-458), coin in the hint bar; '＋' full-width glyph (l.255, 462, 536) and ASCII '+' in '+ To Playlist', '+ Render Clip', '+ Paint Pat'; .icon stroke-width 2 at 1.15em (l.4565-4576)
findings.evidence: '+ Track' uses the Lucide plus while '＋ Add Track' uses a text glyph. 15px raster coins sit beside 2px-stroke line icons in the same rows (1920x1080-z-leftpanel.png). A 2px stroke at about 17px reads heavier than the 15px/500 labels.
findings.proposal: Use the Lucide plus everywhere and drop the glyph text. Keep coins only where they mean $AUDIO or a tier; use Lucide folder/library icons for browser rows. Icon tokens: --icon-sm 16px, --icon-md 18px, stroke-width 1.75, colour currentColor at --text-secondary unless the control is lit.

findings.title: Browser-surface details: Inter settings copied onto Avenir, negative tracking, native tooltips, kbd leftovers
findings.where: html/body letter-spacing -0.011em and font-feature-settings 'cv02','cv03','cv04','cv11' (l.262-266); 94 title= tooltips rendered by the browser; @media (pointer:coarse) kbd{display:none} (l.4112) leaving '( ):' in .panel-footer-tips (1024x1366t-app.png 'Step Rack ():'); scrollbar thumb has no hover state
findings.evidence: The cv02-cv11 values are Inter's character variants and do nothing in Avenir. Negative tracking on light 15px text over dark backgrounds reduces legibility, while the typeset reference asks for slightly more tracking on dark. Tooltips appear after the OS delay in system styling. On touch, the tips read 'Step Rack (): Click…'.
findings.proposal: letter-spacing 0 at 15-16px and -0.01em only at 20px and above. Replace the feature settings with 'kern' (tnum is applied by --font-num). Add a .tooltip primitive (--surface-3, --text-label, radius 4px, --shadow-2, 400ms delay, --dur-fast fade) or rely on the hint bar plus aria-label. Hide the wrapper of a shortcut hint, not just the <kbd>, on touch. Scrollbar: thumb --border-strong, hover --text-muted, 8px wide.

study:ux.summary:
I reviewed the interaction design of the shared primitives by reading index.html, styles.css and the app.js handlers, then used them in Playwright at 1920, 1440, 1366, 1024t, 360t and 640t. I edited no project files. The scripts and evidence screenshots are in /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-DAW/717ea5f2-42d2-5656-8044-03574a727b85/scratchpad/design/work/foundation/ux/ (inventory.cjs, focus.cjs, states.cjs plus states-1440x900-*/sheet.png, keys.cjs, sliders.cjs, touch.cjs, menubar.cjs, contrast.cjs, phonestatus.cjs, undoclear.cjs plus undo-after-clear.png, hit24.cjs, f1.cjs plus f1.png, more-open-1440.png, track-vol-drag.png, daylight-empty.png). The baseline probe shows no page overflow, and text below 15px only in the F1 dialog.

The biggest problems are in behaviour, not looks:
1. Global shortcuts (Space, F-keys, Ctrl combos) stop working once a slider or the tempo field has focus.
2. Hover hints overwrite action results, never clear, and the status bar is hidden on phones, so feedback and errors never reach phone users.
3. Close and delete look the same and sit next to each other, and the one-click Library Clear cannot be undone.
4. "On" states use five unrelated looks, and the selected tool looks the same as a primary action button.

Next come the missing primitive behaviours: a slider that shows its value and resets on double-click, a disabled state, real tooltips, a focus ring that works in every theme, real menus and dialogs, numeric fields, and dB meters. Every proposal keeps all features, keyboard shortcuts and one-click deletes. Most can be built as tokens plus one small shared enhancer in app.js, documented in DESIGN.md.

findings.title: Space, F-keys and Ctrl shortcuts stop working after you touch a slider or type the tempo
findings.where: app.js:4628 (the global keydown handler exits early when activeElement is any INPUT, TEXTAREA or SELECT); app.js:4642 (Escape); #master-vol, #zoom-slider, #hscroll-slider, .mixer-v-fader, #bpm-input, export dialog fields
findings.evidence: keys.cjs at 1440x900. Baseline: Space toggles play and F6 opens the Step Rack. After clicking the master volume, Zoom or Timeline Scroll slider, focus stays on INPUT[range], and Space and F6 both do nothing. The same happens after typing a BPM and pressing Enter (focus stays on INPUT[number]). Escape while typing in the export file-name field does not close the dialog. Riding a fader and then hitting Space to stop is the most common DAW sequence.
findings.proposal: Replace the tag-name check with an isTextEntry(target) check. Exit early only for textarea, contenteditable and input types text, number, search, url, email and password; never for range, checkbox, radio, color or button. When a range slider has focus, the slider keeps the Arrow keys, Home/End and PageUp/PageDown (skip the clip-nudge and zoom branches), but Space, F1/F5-F9, Escape and Ctrl/Meta combos still run. Text fields still honour Escape (revert and blur, or close the dialog) and the F-keys. The tempo and other numeric fields commit and blur on Enter. Selects blur after a change so focus returns to the work area. Every existing shortcut keeps working.

findings.title: Hover hints overwrite action results, never clear, and the status bar does not exist on phones
findings.where: app.js:4216-4221 (the document mouseover handler writes title into #status-pill, bypassing setStatus); app.js:464 setStatus; styles.css:3155-3158 (.fl-hint-bar is display:none !important on compact layouts); index.html:174
findings.evidence: At 1920, clicking M on track 1 leaves the bar reading "Mute Track" (the title of the button re-rendered under the pointer) instead of "Drums Break muted". While dragging a track Vol slider down to about -25 dB, the bar still shows the stale "Track Volume: 1 dB" (track-vol-drag.png). Moving the pointer away never brings the last message back. At 360x640 and 640x360, #status-pill is not rendered, so "Deleted track 3", "Nothing to undo", "Error decoding <file>" and import progress never appear (phonestatus.cjs). There is no role=status or aria-live, and keyboard focus never shows a hint.
findings.proposal: Split the two channels inside one module. (a) Hint: on pointerenter (mouse or pen only) and on focusin, show the control's data-hint (name, shortcut, one line); on pointerleave or focusout, restore the current status. (b) Status: setStatus(msg, {kind: info|success|error, undo}) pins the message for 3 s (errors until the next action), and hover hints wait until it expires. Mirror every status into a visually hidden role=status aria-live=polite node. On the compact breakpoints, show status as a single-line toast above the window switcher: at least 15px text, a 44px Undo button for destructive actions, auto-dismiss after 4 s, and a fade under reduced motion. Colours come from the theme tokens --status-info, --status-success and --status-error.

findings.title: Close and delete look identical and sit side by side, and Library Clear cannot be undone
findings.where: styles.css:791-807 (.panel-close-btn hard-coded #2b1d20/#ffa39e, solid red on hover); styles.css:1212-1217 (.trk-btn.del-trk); app.js:1199-1201 (track delete is a text '×'); index.html:496-497 and 512-513 (Clear pattern/notes right next to Close); app.js:525 pushUndoState snapshots the project only; app.js:1599 clearAllStemsAndClips
findings.evidence: In states-1440x900-audius-dark/sheet.png, the window close ×, the track delete × and the stem trash button share the same red tint and all turn solid red on hover. Closing a window therefore signals danger, and the one-click track delete reads as a close button. In the Step Rack and Piano Roll, the red Clear button sits directly against the red Close. On a phone the track row is M | S | × at equal 44px sizes. One click on Library Clear followed by Ctrl+Z gives back clips with no audio and 0 stems (undo-after-clear.png): the data is permanently lost.
findings.proposal: Close primitive: a neutral ghost icon button (Lucide x, --text-muted; on hover --surface-3 background and --text-primary). It always sits last in the title bar, separated from any action by at least 8px and a 1px divider. Destructive primitive: Lucide trash-2 (or eraser / brush-cleaning) in ghost style, --text-muted at rest, --danger text and --danger-tint background only on hover or focus, never the x glyph. Replace the track '×' text with trash-2. Keep every delete one click, but make each one undoable and announce it as "Deleted X · Undo": the undo entry also keeps the removed AudioBuffers (a tombstone map), so Clear and stem delete become reversible.

findings.title: Five unrelated 'on' looks, and the selected tool looks the same as a primary button
findings.where: styles.css: .tool-btn.active, .action-btn.accent and .tiny-btn.accent share the same gradient; .transport-btn.active and .toggle-pane.active use a hard-coded rgba(34,211,238,.16) cyan tint; styles.css:1200-1210 (.trk-btn.mute.on #d4380d, .solo.on #d48806); .fl-folder-item.active; .swatch-btn.active; .cr-step.active; app.js uses .active/.on classes and sets aria-pressed only on the phone switcher (app.js:3983)
findings.evidence: inventory.cjs: the lit Draw tool and '+ Add Track' render identically (gradient background, #D767E1 border, glow; sheet rows 2 and 3). Loop, metronome and window toggles use a cyan tint. Mute-on is orange-red #D4380D right next to the red delete, so it reads as an error. Solo is amber. The active library folder is blue text on purple. Hovering a lit tool changes nothing. Screen readers get no on/off state.
findings.proposal: Define one state vocabulary in tokens. Primary action = accent gradient fill with white text, used only for commands that create something (Add Track, Upload, To Playlist, Render, Export). Lit (a toggle that is on, or the selected item in a group) = --lit-bg (accent at about 18% over surface-2), --lit-fg (bright accent), a 1px --lit-border and a 2px inner bottom bar acting as an LED; on hover --lit-bg rises to about 26%. Channel states get fixed semantic tokens per theme: --state-mute (desaturated amber; the row and its meter dim), --state-solo (yellow), --state-rec (red), --state-play (green), --state-selected (accent outline). Style these from [aria-pressed=true] and [aria-checked=true] so meaning and look cannot drift apart. Tools become a role=radiogroup, toggles get aria-pressed, and mute/solo titles switch ("Unmute track").

findings.title: Sliders show no value, cannot be reset, and are hard to grab or set precisely
findings.where: index.html:216 #master-vol, :396 #zoom-slider, :492 #cr-swing, :604 #hscroll-slider; app.js ~1225-1255 (track Vol/Pan); .mixer-v-fader; accent-color is teal at styles.css:744 and 1235 but purple at 546, 1416 and 1510
findings.evidence: Track Vol/Pan, Master, Swing and Zoom show no value on screen; there is only a native title. The track sliders' hit box is 78x4 px. Mixer faders travel 60px for -36..+6 dB in 0.5 dB steps (0.7 px per step: an 18px drag went from 0 to -32 dB), and focus is lost after a drag. Double-click does not reset (the value stayed at -25.5). The mouse wheel does nothing, and there is no fine-adjust drag. Pan has no centre mark. Fills are teal on tracks but purple on Master and the Inspector. Timeline Scroll is a value slider used as a scrollbar. The Inspector already does this well with its 'Segment Gain … +0.0 dB' label row.
findings.proposal: Write one slider enhancer in app.js, driven by data attributes (data-default, data-unit, data-format=db|pan|pct|st, data-bipolar). It shows the live value in the label row (the Inspector pattern), or as a value bubble during drag and focus where there is no room (track rows, faders). Double-click and Ctrl/Cmd-click reset to data-default. Shift-drag moves at 1/10 speed (pointer capture with a custom delta). The wheel adjusts only while the slider has focus, so scrolling is never hijacked. Arrows step, Shift+arrows step ×10. CSS: one appearance:none track (4px, --surface-0 with --border) with the filled part from a --fill-pct custom property in the accent or state colour. The thumb is 14px with a 24px hit area on desktop, and 28px with a 44px hit area on touch. Bipolar sliders get a centre tick. Faders should get at least 120px of travel wherever the mixer pass allows. Scrolling should use a scrollbar-style control (playlist pass).

findings.title: No disabled state exists, so unavailable commands look available
findings.where: app.js:1308-1433 and 1514-1603 (status-only 'Select a clip first…' messages); index.html:347-373 and 392-393; styles.css has no :disabled styling (only button:active:not(:disabled) at 4490)
findings.evidence: In a fresh project, Undo, Redo, Delete Clip, Split @ Playhead, Cut Half and Nudge are all enabled (keys.cjs). Clicking them with nothing to act on only writes a hint, which phones never show. The Export button is set to disabled during a render but looks exactly the same.
findings.proposal: Add a disabled primitive: [disabled] and [aria-disabled=true] get --text-disabled, no hover or press effect, and cursor:not-allowed. Use aria-disabled where the control should stay focusable so its tooltip can explain ("Select a clip to split"). Add syncCommandAvailability(), called from onProjectMutated, selection changes and undo/redo: Undo/Redo follow the stack lengths, clip commands follow the selection, and Clear follows whether there is anything to clear. Add a busy variant (aria-busy plus a spinner icon) for Export and Import.

findings.title: Long-press on touch can delete clips and notes, because every contextmenu event is treated as a right-click delete
findings.where: app.js:2841-2853 (playlist canvas contextmenu deletes the clip under the pointer); app.js:2496-2514 (piano roll deletes the note); app.js:2251 (step clears)
findings.evidence: These handlers delete on any contextmenu event and never check pointerType. Chrome on Android fires contextmenu after a ~500ms long-press, so resting a finger on a clip before dragging it would delete it. This comes from reading the code: Playwright cannot emulate Android's long-press, so it needs checking on the Note 3. The F1 sheet itself documents "Right-Click Clip: Delete Clip immediately".
findings.proposal: Define one long-press rule for the whole app. In contextmenu handlers, if e.pointerType is 'touch' (or a touch pointer was down within the last 600ms), call preventDefault and open the clip context menu or the tooltip instead of deleting. A mouse right-click keeps its one-click delete.

findings.title: Tooltips are slow native titles: long, brand-prefixed, with the shortcut buried and nothing on keyboard focus or touch
findings.where: 94 title attributes in index.html plus titles set in app.js (e.g. app.js:1180, 1191); the swatch titles at index.html:232-237
findings.evidence: The longest title is 119 characters ("Audius Paint Brush Tool (B). Click & drag horizontally…"). Shortcuts sit mid-sentence and disagree with the key chips ("P or 1" vs P). Chrome shows them after about 1 s, unstyled. Nothing appears on keyboard focus or on touch. The mute and solo titles never change with state. The swatches say "Official Audius Dark (#242438 …)", which suggests an official product.
findings.proposal: Add a tooltip primitive: name plus key chips, with any one-line description going to the hint bar only. Delay 450ms, instant when moving between neighbouring controls within 300ms. position:fixed with flipping, so it escapes overflow. Also shown on :focus-visible. Suppressed on touch, where a 500ms long-press on non-performance controls shows it without firing the action (not on pads, steps, keys or faders). Feed everything from one SHORTCUTS table in app.js (command id → keys, label): tooltips, key chips, menu shortcut columns and the F1 sheet. Move long copy into data-hint, keep aria-label on icon buttons, and drop the 'Audius' and 'Official' prefixes.

findings.title: Focus ring missing on the tempo field, same colour as lit toggles, weak in some themes; some click targets cannot be reached by keyboard
findings.where: styles.css:4289 (:focus-visible uses --accent-teal); styles.css:527 (.bpm-box input:focus { outline:none }) and :341; .fl-folder-item (div), .fl-menu-item (span), #time-readout-box (div, 'Click to return to Bar 1')
findings.evidence: focus.cjs: of 65 tab stops, all show a 2px teal ring except #bpm-input, which shows nothing and has no accessible name. The ring colour is the same teal as lit Loop and window toggles. It turns magenta in the ocean theme and measures 2.83:1 against the daylight panel (3.23:1 in ocean). Around a track Vol slider, the ring overlaps the 'Pan' label (track-vol-drag.png). The library folders, the menu words and the time readout respond only to mouse clicks.
findings.proposal: Add a --focus-ring token per theme, drawn two-tone: a 2px ring in --focus-color plus a 1px --surface-0 inner halo via box-shadow, at least 3:1 against surfaces 0-3 and visibly different from --lit. Default outline-offset 2px; 1px or inset inside dense rows. Remove the outline:none rules. Make the folders a radio or tab group of buttons, and make the time readout a real button.

findings.title: Things that look like menus and dropdowns are not: the menu words run commands on click, and the chevron badges do nothing
findings.where: index.html:161-170 and app.js:4202-4215 (menu words); index.html:486 and 613 (.fl-win-badge 'All ▾', 'Wide ▾')
findings.evidence: menubar.cjs at 1920: after muting track 1, clicking EDIT silently undid it ("Undo applied"). ADD added "Audio Track 6". OPTIONS turned the typing keyboard on. In code, TOOLS runs Auto-Slice on the selection and PATTERNS stamps a pattern. The words are spans with tabIndex -1, no role and no title. The 'All ▾' and 'Wide ▾' badges show a chevron but are inert spans with cursor:auto.
findings.proposal: Build a menu primitive for the menus pass: a menu-bar button (aria-haspopup=menu, aria-expanded) opens a fixed-position popover menu that supports arrow keys, Esc and outside-click to close. Items show right-aligned shortcut chips from SHORTCUTS: File (Save, Open, Export…), Edit (Undo, Redo, Cut/Copy/Paste, Delete, Select all), Add (Track, Marker, Upload stems), Patterns, View (window toggles with check states), Options, Tools, Help. Until that exists, clicking a menu word must not run a command. Remove the chevron from the badges, or make them real selects.

findings.title: Dialogs neither take nor return focus, keep focus inside, or close on Escape in a field or on a backdrop click; the F1 sheet is small and out of date
findings.where: index.html:764-894 (.modal-backdrop divs toggled with hidden); app.js:4620-4648
findings.evidence: Opening Export leaves focus on the button that opened it. Twelve Tabs move to the page behind. Escape in a field does nothing, and clicking the backdrop does nothing. After closing, focus lands on BODY. There is no role=dialog or aria-modal. The F1 text renders at 14.5px (from an inline font-size:12px). Keys are mixed inline with '·', and the sheet leaves out K, R, Delete, PageUp/PageDown, the 1-6 tool keys and Ctrl+Shift+Z, and describes Backspace only as 'Toggle Grid Snap' although it deletes when clips are selected.
findings.proposal: Use <dialog> with showModal() for the shared frame: native focus trap, Escape, ::backdrop and an inert page behind. On open, focus the first field or the primary button; on close, return focus to the opener. A backdrop click closes non-destructive dialogs. The dialog title bar uses the same panel-title primitive. Render F1 from SHORTCUTS as grouped two-column tables (Action | Keys) with right-aligned key chips at 15px.

findings.title: Number fields: native spinners double up beside the tempo's −/+ buttons; no drag-scrub, units or label
findings.where: index.html:199-204 (.bpm-box #bpm-input); the Inspector number fields at index.html:656-706
findings.evidence: Hovering the tempo shows Chrome's spin arrows next to the custom −/+ buttons (the bpm input row in sheet.png). The tempo cannot be dragged, there is no Enter-to-commit, and the field has no accessible name. The Inspector fields (Start, Length, Offset, Fades) have their units only in the label and cannot be scrubbed, although desktop DAW users expect to drag numbers.
findings.proposal: Add a numeric field primitive: appearance:textfield (no native spinners), tabular figures, a unit suffix inside the field, ArrowUp/Down ±step (Shift ×10, Alt ÷10), wheel while focused, and vertical drag-scrub with an ns-resize cursor when not editing (double-click or Enter to type). Enter commits and blurs; Escape reverts and blurs. Give it an aria-label ("Tempo, BPM").

findings.title: Meters are linear and jittery, with no peak hold, clip light or scale
findings.where: app.js animationTick (meter width = level × 115%, mixer meter height = level × 125%); audio-engine.js:321-346 (raw peak per frame); styles.css:564-569 and 1238-1250 (hard-coded #52c41a/#fadb14/#ff4d4f and #0c0e11/#0d1014 troughs)
findings.evidence: Because the scale is linear amplitude, -12 dBFS fills 29%, -24 dBFS fills 7%, and anything above -1.2 dBFS is pinned at 100%. There is no peak hold, no latched clip indicator and no 0 dB mark. A 40ms linear transition on raw per-frame peaks makes the bars flicker. The troughs stay black in the daylight theme.
findings.proposal: Add a meter primitive that maps -60..+6 dBFS to length, with ticks at 0, -6, -12, -24 and -48. Use fast attack and about 300ms release in JS, a 1.5 s peak-hold line, a clip light that stays on until clicked, and a numeric peak readout on the master. Add tokens --meter-ok, --meter-hot, --meter-clip and --meter-trough. Under reduced motion the meters keep updating, because they show data rather than decoration.

findings.title: Desktop click targets under 24px
findings.where: .panel-close-btn, .pat-song-btn, .bpm-step-btn, #bpm-input, inspector and trellis checkboxes, input[type=range], .cr-step
findings.evidence: hit24.cjs at 1440: close buttons 22x22 (5 of them), PAT/SONG 60x21, BPM −/+ 22x24, BPM field 52x20, checkboxes 13x13 (3), range inputs 16px tall (19; the track sliders are only 4px), step buttons 43x20 (64). WCAG 2.5.8 asks for at least 24x24.
findings.proposal: Add a --hit-min-desktop: 24px token and meet it with padding or an invisible ::after hit box, so nothing changes visually. Checkbox primitive: an 18px box whose whole row is the label. Better still, make Reverse and Mute in the Inspector, and Stamp to Playlist in the pads dock, lit toggle buttons.

findings.title: The control vocabulary has drifted: 9 heights, 4 radii, mixed cursors, and text glyphs used as icons
findings.where: styles.css (tool-btn 34, mini-btn 34, tiny-btn 26, action-btn 36, transport 32, nudge 32, asset actions 28, trk-btn 24, summaries 44); index.html:255, 462, 536 ('＋'); app.js:1201, 1916, 1939, 2062 ('×')
findings.evidence: inventory.cjs: button heights are 21, 22, 24, 26, 28, 32, 34, 36 and 44; radii are 3, 4, 5 and 7; weights run from 400 to 800. Selects are 34 vs 36px tall and use cursor:default in the tool bar but pointer in Options. Full-width '＋' and text '×' glyphs sit next to Lucide icons.
findings.proposal: Add size tokens --ctl-h-sm 24, --ctl-h-md 32 and --ctl-h-lg 40 (44 on touch); radius tokens --radius-sm 4, --radius-md 6 and --radius-lg 10; and allow only weights 500, 600 and 700. Define the button variants primary, secondary, ghost, icon, danger-ghost and lit in DESIGN.md. Replace '＋' and '×' with the i-plus, i-x and i-trash-2 icons.

findings.title: Shared controls use hard-coded colours, so they break in the light theme
findings.where: styles.css:791-807, 1212-1217, 512, 564-569; app.js drawOscilloscope (#171825, #CC0FE0); app.js:986-988 (library empty state set by inline style)
findings.evidence: contrast.cjs, daylight theme: danger text 1.55:1, lit Loop 2.26:1, stem metadata 2.44:1, status 2.47:1, focus ring 2.83:1. The close button measures exactly 8.45:1 in all 9 themes, which shows it is hard-coded. In daylight the BPM −/+ buttons, the oscilloscope and the meter troughs stay black boxes, and the drop zone text becomes illegible (daylight-empty.png). The library empty state is 11.5px #93a1b0.
findings.proposal: Add per-theme role tokens --danger-fg and --danger-tint, and keep --lit-fg at least 3:1 on surface-2. Canvases read their colours from the tokens through getComputedStyle once per theme change. Add an empty-state primitive: 15px text in --text-secondary, plus one button for the next useful action ("Load demo", "Upload stems").

findings.title: Copy: 'Audius' and 'Official' prefixes on controls, leftover 'FL' and 'Ubuntu' strings, and mixed title casing
findings.where: index.html:487, 507, 614, 624 (panel titles); tool and swatch titles; wallpaper options at index.html:279-282; app.js:3112 and 3439; app.js:244
findings.evidence: Panel titles read 'Audius Step Rack', 'Audius Piano Roll', 'Audius Studio Mixer' and 'AUDIUS FX CHAIN'. Tooltips say 'Audius Draw Tool' and 'Official Audius Dark', and wallpapers are marked '(Audius Official)'. Status messages include '(FL Shift+Drag)' and '(FL Alt+Wheel)'.
